summary: Frontend end-to-end verification of the 3 requested changes on the AzoApp admin panel. All three features verified working: (1) Every section row in Customer App Home 'Sections — order & visibility' has a data-testid section-remove-<key> trash button (8 present: categories, offer_banner, quick_features, most_booked, why_choose, trending, salon, offers). Deleting 'why_choose' + Save changes + reload → row remains removed (persistence confirmed). (2) 'Branding (header)' card is absent from Customer App Home. (3) Homepage Builder Type dropdown (data-testid hp-add-type) exposes 'Hand-picked services', 'Category services (whole category)' and 'Promo banner (image + link)'. Selecting each shows correct config fields: hp-config-services multi-select for hand-picked (3 services selected OK), hp-config-category for category services, banner image uploader + hp-config-link input for promo banner. Added a 'Category services' section (AC Repair & Service, title 'TEST Cat Services') and a 'Hand-picked services' section (title 'TEST Hand-picked', 3 picked services) via hp-add-submit — sections count grew 7 → 8 → 9, both got hp-del-<i> entries. Public storefront ({base}/api/panel/) after reload rendered both TEST sections (body innerText contained 'TEST Cat Services' and 'TEST Hand-picked').
